purpose: One fresh teaching per class and one query scored across both accepted class memories; no utility estimate or tuning.

teaching.label: card_arrival
teaching.text: My replacement debit card was dispatched last week, but it still hasn't arrived.

teaching.label: cash_withdrawal_charge
teaching.text: The ATM dispensed my cash, but there is an extra withdrawal fee on my statement.

query.text: Why was I charged an extra fee when I took money out of an ATM?

encoder_invocation: One fresh local E5 batch of the two teaching texts followed by the query; labels are not encoder inputs.
feature_map: Existing E5 768-to576 fixed projection, scale512/clip127; then existing numpy.rint(first576/4), ties-to-even, bound32 and norm_squared<=20000.
model: One lane0 observation per class in the existing eight-lane degree2 kernel memory; no expiry in this minimal fresh workload.
reader: Full BFV reader key; exactly two class-output decryptions, deferred until update and query proof acceptance. Plaintext public trusted issuer and known public text fixture.
